content: Hi, I'm on a short break before my shift, so I need straight answers. My 15-year-old is failing Algebra II at 58% with a final in six weeks, and I'm looking at Willowbend. What's the total monthly cost with all fees included, and how do I cancel if it doesn't work? I got burned by a gym contract last year, so I'm not signing anything until I know.

Hi, I’m Maya. 

- **Core plan:** $49 /month all‑included (or $39 /month for the first 2 months if you enroll by Dec 15, then $49).  
- **Plus plan:** $89 /month all‑included.  

There are no hidden fees. You can cancel anytime from your account page; the cancellation stops the next month’s renewal and carries no fee. The only condition is a mandatory 14‑day activation wait before the first chat session.  

Does the Core plan sound like the right fit for your teen? If so, you can enroll at [willowbendlearning.example/enroll](https://willowbendlearning.example/enroll).

Before anything else: what is the full monthly cost of Willowbend AI Math Tutor with every fee included, and how do I cancel if it isn't working? I got stuck in a contract last year and won't do that again.

Sure thing!  

**Full monthly cost (all taxes & fees included)**  
- **Core plan:** $49 /month (or $39 /month for the first 2 months if you enroll by Dec 15, then $49).  
- **Plus plan:** $89 /month.  

**Cancelation:** Log into the student’s account, go to the “Account” page, and click “Cancel subscription.” Cancellation takes effect after the current paid month ends—no cancellation fee, no hidden charges.  

Let me know if you’d like to move forward or have any other questions!

Okay, that helps, but you still haven't answered two things directly. Does the 14-day activation wait mean my son gets zero help in the first two weeks of the six before his final? And if I cancel mid-month, do I get a refund for the unused part, or do I just stop future charges? Also, does the Core plan cover the 8th-grade gaps like fractions and solving equations, or only Algebra II?

Great questions—here are the straight answers:

* **14‑day activation wait:** The AI tutor isn’t usable until day 14 after sign‑up, so there’s no chat‑based help in the first two weeks. (You can still complete the initial diagnostic, but practice sessions start on day 14.)  
* **Cancel‑mid‑month refund:** Cancel anytime from the account page; the subscription stops after the current paid month ends. We don’t issue prorated refunds for the unused days—future charges simply cease.  
* **Core plan coverage:** It includes all Algebra II units **plus** the built‑in 8th‑grade review of fractions and basic equation‑solving skills.

If that works for you, the Core plan (now $39 /month for the first 2 months, then $49) can be started at [willowbendlearning.example/enroll](https://willowbendlearning.example/enroll). Let me know if you’d like to proceed or have any other concerns!

Okay, so to be sure I have this right: no help at all for the first 14 days, no prorated refund if I cancel mid-month, and the 8th-grade review is included in Core. Can you confirm in writing, in the account terms or an email, that the 14-day wait and no-refund policy are stated there? Also, what does a progress report show me, so I can tell whether my son is actually improving before the final?

Yes—those three points are correct. The 14‑day activation wait and the “no prorated refund” rule are both spelled out in our Terms & Conditions, which you can view here: https://willowbendlearning.example/terms.  

Just so you know, Willowbend AI Math Tutor does **not** provide a parent‑focused progress report or dashboard on any plan; only the student’s own practice history is visible inside the app.  

If you’d like to move forward with the Core plan (now $39 /month for the first 2 months, then $49), you can enroll at [willowbendlearning.example/enroll](https://willowbendlearning.example/enroll). Let me know if you need anything else!

So no parent progress reports at all, and I can only see my son's own practice history, which he controls. That's a dealbreaker for me, since I need to know he's actually improving before the final. Also, a 14-day wait with no help when the final is six weeks away is a big chunk of our time. I'll look at the free homework club and other options before I spend anything. Thanks for being straight with me.
